title: The AOP Bomber — Unisex
text: A unisex all-over-print bomber jacket. The BV monogram + star grid covers every panel — front anchored by a centered star at the zip line, back and sleeves running the full repeating tile. Lightweight, color-locked polyester shell. Ribbed cuffs and hem. Anchor piece of the AOP capsule. Built to be Kept.

title: The AOP Hoodie — Unisex
text: A unisex all-over-print pullover hoodie. The BV monogram + star pattern runs unbroken across the chest, back, sleeves, hood, and pocket. No interruption, no center motif — just the field. Recycled polyester sustainable fleece. Drawcord hood. Front kangaroo pocket. Built to be Kept.

title: The AOP Jersey — Unisex
text: A premium all-over-print basketball jersey. Sleeveless cut, mesh-feel polyester, the BV monogram + star pattern tiling across both panels. Loose drape. Lifestyle athletic — not court-spec, but cut to be worn. Built for warm-weather wear and recognition at twenty paces. Built to be Kept.

title: The AOP Sweatshirt — Unisex
text: A unisex all-over-print crew sweatshirt. Pullover construction, no placket — the BV monogram + star pattern tiles edge to edge across every panel. Recycled polyester sustainable fleece. Ribbed cuffs and hem. Built to layer. Built to be Kept.

title: The AOP Tee — Men's
text: A men's all-over-print crew tee. The BV monogram + star pattern tiles edge to edge — front, back, sleeves — printed into the fabric before the panels are cut and sewn. Smooth color-locked polyester. Crew neck. Cut-sewn so the print continues uninterrupted across every plane. Built to be Kept.

title: The AOP Tee — Women's
text: A women's all-over-print crew tee. Tailored fit, smooth color-locked polyester, the BV monogram + star pattern running edge to edge across every panel. Crew neck. Cut-sewn. The print never breaks at the seam. Built to be Kept.

title: The Beanie
text: A cuffed knit beanie in fine-gauge acrylic. Ribbed fold-up cuff. Structured crown that holds shape after wash. The BV monogram embroidered in Old Gold thread at the cuff front. One size, stretches. Soft enough to layer under a hood, structured enough to wear alone. Built to be Kept.

title: The Cap
text: A premium structured 6-panel cap. Wool-blend front, mid-profile crown, slightly curved bill — the cut every refined streetwear shop reaches for. The BV monogram embroidered prominently in Old Gold thread at the front center. The brand mark is the entire point of a cap. Stretch-fit band, no closure on the back — sits like it was made for your head. Built to be Kept.

title: The Crew Sock
text: A ribbed mid-calf crew sock made in the USA from premium combed cotton. The BV monogram is embroidered in Old Gold thread on the outside cuff — visible above sneakers and loafers, hidden under boots and dress shoes. Reinforced heel and toe. Cushioned footbed. Fit holds without slipping. Built to be Kept.

title: The Polo

Three-button placket with dyed-to-match buttons. Flat-knit collar. Side-vented hem. Tagless interior. Modern slim cut. Built to be Kept.
